glosses: you mustn't …; it won't do to …
patterns.usage_note: Warns that performing an action, once or repeatedly, leads to a bad result, so it lands as a caution and often closes with だめだ or いけない: 飲んじゃ, やめちゃ. It attaches to a verb in て-form; the voiced て-forms of む, ぶ, ぬ and ぐ verbs give じゃ (飲んじゃ, 泳いじゃ) and the rest give ちゃ. The siblings attach to a noun or an adjective instead: a supposed condition, 六時じゃ, and the present situation taken as grounds, この雨じゃ.

examples.ruby: そんなに飲[の]んじゃ明日[あした]の朝[あさ]が辛[つら]いよ。
examples.english: Drink that much and you'll pay for it in the morning.

examples.ruby: 途中[とちゅう]でやめちゃ今[いま]までの努力[どりょく]が無駄[むだ]だよ。
examples.english: Quit halfway and everything you've put in so far goes to waste.

examples.ruby: 毎日[まいにち]夜更[よふ]かしをしちゃ授業[じゅぎょう]に集中[しゅうちゅう]できない。
examples.english: Stay up late every night and you'll never be able to focus in class.
